scope: Follow-up public-data search for an independent synchronized station-to-vehicle fueling holdout

eligibility_rule.required_rights: explicit public reuse or written permission for derived metrics and journal publication

candidates.title: Hydrogen Refueling Station Capacity Dataset for California
candidates.license: No explicit repository license field observed
candidates.finding: File-level inspection found 2,563 CSV files for 36 California stations, 2018-09-27 through 2018-12-18, with approximately 30-minute Time/H35/H70 capacity indicators. No synchronized vehicle pressure, temperature, mass flow or protocol trace is public.
candidates.reuse_status: Cite and link only until data dictionary and written reuse terms are clarified; excluded from physical full-loop validation.

candidates.title: HRSs refueling perfromance Data sets
candidates.finding: The public description identifies modeling and simulation results plus input parameters and time-resolved simulated outputs. It is not an independent measured station or vehicle experiment.
candidates.reuse_status: Open metadata and CC BY record; excluded from physical external validation and cannot be used to claim field agreement.

candidates.title: European H2-Stations export API
candidates.finding: The API exposes station metadata, availability, events, usage, hydrogen storage and pricing signals. It does not expose a synchronized pressure-temperature-mass-flow trace for a vehicle-fueling event.
candidates.reuse_status: Open CC BY station-context data; not eligible for the numerical full-loop holdout.

candidates.title: California Hydrogen Refueling Stations – Lessons for Texas
candidates.finding: The repository record is a technical report about deployment lessons and infrastructure status. It does not provide synchronized station-to-vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow rows.
candidates.reuse_status: The report may support contextual citation; no raw numerical holdout is available from the record.

candidates.title: HRS-Modell free simulation model
candidates.finding: The public page describes a MATLAB/Simulink model validated by the developers with their own measurements. It provides a simulator, not an independently released measured station-to-vehicle trace archive.
candidates.reuse_status: Useful model-comparison lead only; simulator outputs cannot be promoted to a physical external holdout.

candidates.title: ELVHYS 4.2 - Leakage into cold room/tank connection space considering barriers and obstacles
candidates.finding: The Dataverse manifest exposes 198 files from 48 cryogenic hydrogen transfer-connection-space experiments covering concentration, pressure, temperature, ventilation flow, pressure peaking and deliberate ignition. It is openly reusable and has synchronized time-series files, but it is not a gaseous H70 station-to-vehicle fueling trace.

observed_scope.facility: 1 m3 transfer-connection space at HSE Science & Research Centre, Buxton, UK

candidates.reuse_status: CC0 permits reuse; cite the metadata/readme date discrepancy and keep the source in a declared cryogenic domain-transfer protocol. It cannot close the station full-loop gate.

candidates.title: Enhanced Thermofluidic Modeling and Open Source Rigorous Simulation of Hydrogen Fueling Systems Validated with Real-world Data
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 preprint; linked code-folder access unverified
candidates.finding: The study reports six real HRS scenarios with vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow measurements. Anonymous access to the cited Google Drive folder redirected to Google sign-in and returned no files, so no raw synchronized archive or reuse terms were available for a frozen holdout. The supplement recheck found only a two-page Appendix with Tables A.1-A.3; the appendix hash and no-raw-logger boundary are frozen in the linked recheck artifact.
candidates.reuse_status: Request the de-identified logger export, channel/calibration metadata and written IJHE reuse terms from the KGS data custodian before outcome access.

candidates.title: Development, Application and Optimization of Hydrogen Refueling Processes for Railway Vehicles
candidates.license: Open-access article; no raw-logger reuse licence identified on the repository item
candidates.finding: The DLR item states that FCH2RAIL station and vehicle measurements were analyzed for model validation, but the repository exposes the article PDF only and no machine-readable synchronized logger archive. It therefore cannot be scored as an untouched holdout from the public item.
candidates.reuse_status: Request a de-identified synchronized export, channel dictionary, calibration metadata and written permission for derived metrics and repository deposit from DLR/FCH2RAIL custodians before any outcome access.

candidates.title: Enhancing High-Flow Hydrogen Refueling: Mitigation of Pressure Losses in Storage and Delivery Systems
candidates.finding: The Zenodo record provides a GT-Suite/GEM-3D one-dimensional simulation study and presentation files for a Czech-republic station model. It does not provide measured station-to-vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow observations.
candidates.reuse_status: Cite as an open modelling reference only; simulation outputs cannot replace an independent measured holdout or be used as external physical validation.

next_action: Obtain a de-identified synchronized logger export and written reuse terms from a custodian such as Cal State LA HRFF, NREL/NLR HITRF, CARB/HyStEP, JRC GasTeF, FCH2RAIL or an HRS operator; freeze model, inclusion criteria and scoring before reading numerical outcomes.
claim_boundary: This record documents a search and exclusion decision. It does not add validation evidence, change frozen results or permit a publication-readiness claim.
